title: 括号生成
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: One complete static Chinese algorithm explanation image for Bamboo Copter's dark desktop app. The user finds the old animation abstract; make the algorithm concrete and understandable on this single image.
Style: refined modern editorial educational infographic, flat precise diagrams, crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, balanced whitespace, readable labels. Landscape around 3:2. Deep charcoal background #171b20, warm white text, muted grey secondary text, restrained mint and amber accents. Main algorithm diagram occupies most of the canvas. Thin accurate arrows, small clean step numbers, distinguish indexes from values. No glossy 3D, mascot, decorative illustration, dashboard widgets, fake app window, play buttons, watermarks or full solution code. No excessive nested cards or huge empty areas. Use visual steps connected in reading order. ALL examples, indexes, formulas and Chinese labels below must be accurate and readable. Render only the specified content, with short explanatory Chinese labels; do not invent additional numerical examples. Main title top left, input directly underneath, 3-4 visual sections, and a compact complexity footer. The result should be visible immediately and the intermediate steps must explain how it was obtained.

Title "59  括号生成". Input "n=3". Subtitle "只扩展合法前缀, 回溯尝试下一种选择".
LEFT main panel must be a large precise state TABLE, NOT a branching tree. Headers "步数 | 6格字符路径 | open | close". EACH character has its own square cell. Exactly SIX cells per row, exactly SEVEN rows:
step0: [·,·,·,·,·,·], open0 close0
step1: [(,·,·,·,·,·], open1 close0
step2: [(,(,·,·,·,·], open2 close0
step3: [(,(,(,·,·,·], open3 close0
step4: [(,(,(,),·,·], open3 close1
step5: [(,(,(,),),·], open3 close2
step6: [(,(,(,),),)], open3 close3.
Here "(" and ")" are single literal characters. "·" is an unfilledcell, NOT part ofresult. Separate glyphs in cells make exact counts visible. Label "图中是一条成功路径: ((()))".
RIGHT section1 rules: "open:已用左括号数, close:已用右括号数". "open<n 才能放左括号";"close<open 才能放右括号";"0≤close≤open≤n". Starting cannot choose")" because0<0false.
RIGHT section2 explicit backtracking alternatives from step2: three cells "(,(,·)" with counts2,0. Can fill thirdcell"(" because2<3, or fillthirdcell")" because0<2. Two tiny option rows show "(,(,(" with counts3,0 and "(,(,)" with counts2,1. All three-character arrays must have exactly3cells. "返回时删末尾, 再试另一种允许的括号". Use mutable character path, length2ncopyanswer.
RIGHT section3 result EXACT five lines, each rendered with6separate charcells:
((())) ; (()()) ; (())() ; ()(()) ; ()()().
Everyresult exactly6cells with3left3right, no quotes inside cells. "共5个有效组合".
Footer "时间O(n·C_n)    辅助空间O(n)". "n为括号对数,C_n为第n个Catalan数;可变字符路径+栈,不含输出". All rows, char counts and number columns must exactly match; no abstract arrows.
edits: Fix exact text only, preserve all counts, branches, arrows, final5results,style. In MIDDLE branch diagram TOP state(2,0), replace corrupted parenthesis text with EXACT two left-parenthesis characters '((' and NO quote/apostrophe inside box. In RIGHT branch state(3,2), replace its corrupted text containing a stray apostrophe with EXACT five characters '(()()': left,left,right,left,right, counts(3,2). In LEFT panel initial(0,0) box, replace lonely quote with Chinese '空路径'. Do not change the five complete valid result strings. Keep all rules and O(n) auxiliary space because mutable character path. Render monospace parentheses at even spacing, with no quotation symbols in state boxes.

Correct the three LOWER state strings in the RIGHT column of the MIDDLE branch panel only. Use SPACE-SEPARATED parenthesis characters to make counts inspectable, no quotes/apostrophes: box labelled(3,1) must display '( ( ) (' (open,open,close,open,4 characters); box(3,2) must display '( ( ) ( )' (open,open,close,open,close,5 characters); box(3,3) must display '( ( ) ( ) )' (open,open,close,open,close,close,6 characters). These are prefixes of (()()). Keep counts(3,1)/(3,2)/(3,3) unchanged. Preserve correct right first box(2,1)string(() and ALL left-branch strings, all arrow labels, final5outputs, rules, complexity and layout. review.steps: 重新生成单字符格后,主表7行每行6格,各步open/close为0/0,1/0,2/0,3/0,3/1,3/2,3/3. 从2/0前三格选择(得3/0、选择)得2/1,条件分别2<3和0<2. 所有5结果6格逐字符核对,没有多余引号/撇号.
review.complexity: 可变字符路径和递归栈 O(n),复制 C_n个长度2n答案时间 O(n·C_n),输出排除. 原json O(n²)是每帧不可变字符串复制,此图明确改用可变路径并同步 O(n).
